## Opening Balance Sheet Adjustment on January 1, 2018

|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|------------------------------------|----------------------------|

| Prepaid expenses and other current assets | 44.6                            | 11.8                               | 56.4                       |

| Total assets                              | 3,655.9                         | 20.3                               | 3,676.2                    |
| Deferred revenues (current)               | 59.6                            | (1.9)                              | 57.7                       |
| Deferred revenues (non-current)           | 100.7                           | 6.8                                | 107.5                      |
